source_summary: Misty ink landscape with tall distant peaks above a river-and-village foreground. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: faint_left_background_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the pale, mist-softened vertical mountain silhouette behind the main peak on the upper left, including only its translucent ink wash and blurred summit contour.
must_preserve: subtle darker base fading into surrounding haze

motifs.name: dark_central_misty_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant dark central peak with a rounded summit, steep sides, and diagonal pale mist band cutting across its face.
must_preserve: dry-brush stippled texture along both ridges
diagonal reserve of pale mist across the slope
graduated wash fading at the lower foot

motifs.name: right_overlapping_mountain_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the overlapping smaller peaks and sloping ridges to the right of the central mountain, including the saddle, dark crests, and receding misty base.

motifs.name: left_riverside_hamlet_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground riverside hamlet: two low houses with slanted roofs tucked among tall trees and bamboo-like trunks beside the shore.
must_preserve: dark ink mass at far-left foliage
pale shoreline wash beneath the buildings

motifs.name: middle_lake_tree_belt
motifs.description: Isolate the midground lake edge with a horizontal belt of pale trees, small wooded clumps, low banks, and calm water openings behind the village.

motifs.name: narrow_stream_footbridge
motifs.description: Isolate the small narrow footbridge spanning the stream in the lower middle-left, with tiny vertical supports and adjacent pale banks.
must_preserve: small upright marks at the crossing
pale water reserve around the bridge

motifs.name: right_pine_grove_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground grove and pavilion: dense dark pines leaning over a small roofed structure on the bank, with adjacent pale tree trunks and hillside wash.
must_preserve: small pavilion roof triangle and wall lines
contrast between dark grove and pale background trees

motifs.name: foreground_water_rocks_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground water surface and shoreline rocks below the right grove, including horizontal ripples, low gray banks, and rounded stones.
must_preserve: subtle dark accents at rock bases

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
